train_sentencepiece_bpe_model: train a SentencePiece BPE model from a text corpus and export a fairseq dictionary
generate_subword_vocabulary: generate a subword vocabulary with a specified size using SentencePiece BPE tokenization
export_fairseq_dictionary: export a fairseq-compatible dictionary file from a trained SentencePiece model
train_model_with_special_symbols: train a SentencePiece model with user-defined special symbols for custom tokenization
review_gen_vocab_function: review the gen_vocab function that trains SentencePiece and exports fairseq dictionaries
